test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only three people are sitting between D and I. There are only two people sitting between K and O. I is sitting to the immediate left of O. No one is sitting to the left of D. Only one person is sitting to the right of O. How many people are sitting in the row ?
solution:
Given → A certain number of people are sitting in a straight line facing north.

1)Only three people are sitting between D and I. No one is sitting to the left of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36bf537b872bbbe5855f5e489e1d124074c4fc4ea5950346e50354dd00ca650c.png] 

2) I is sitting to the immediate left of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5b0b640240e220cbc2f6c81be594566e0a6a980a3234c542fed43ad99f24d7c.png] 

3) Only one person is sitting to the right of O. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/387c94b5c6b96ed8d68db72bf9cf0e4a342576ff352e93686b10f428cee11fb8.png] 

3) There are only two people sitting between K and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6ae85401d0d601bab76121026b4c925aea377f6a9bf765a2acff62781ac1560.png] 

As can be seen, there are **7** people sitting in a straight line facing north.

Hence, the correct answer is **"7".**
